name: elagoht/tenant
description: A collage plugin that serves one site to many customers, each on a host of its own — acme.app.com, globex.app.com, or a customer's own domain — with every absolute URL the site writes following the host.
setup: List the tenants in plugins-config.json under `"tenants"` (`id`, `origin`, `hosts`), or pass `Resolve` from Go: `tenant.New(tenant.Options{Resolve: lookup})`. With neither, the application stops at startup with ErrNoTenants.

config.description: A collage plugin that serves one site to many customers, each on a host of its own — acme.app.com, globex.app.com, or a customer's own domain — with every absolute URL the site writes following the host.

bypass.description: Bypass are hosts served without a tenant: the product's own site, say, on app.com.

maxHosts.description: MaxHosts bounds how many hosts' answers are kept, so a client sending random Host headers cannot grow memory or make Resolve run without end. Zero means 10000; a negative value is an error.

tenants.description: Tenants are the tenants known from configuration. They are looked up before Resolve.

ttl.description: TTL is how long Resolve's answer for a host is kept, "is no tenant" included, written as a string: "30s". Zero means "1m".
